source_message.text:
Findings
The ETH mint reverted (0x3af7…0855c on Base) because the on-chain swap router is configured as 0x2626…e481, which is not the Uniswap V3 SwapRouter. The contract invokes exactInputSingle at that address, causing a revert, so all ETH mints will fail until the router is fixed on-chain.

The USDC mint works;
- token #1 exists and belongs to 0x3b55868Dd2ebA28f97b3dB55a4cB706a078154B5. Its metadata and assets resolve successfully:
- Metadata: [URL_024]
- Image: [URL_025]

execution.observed_behavior: A production token's metadata and image asset endpoints were checked and resolved successfully.

routing_warnings.description: The NFT was visible in Rabby but displayed no image or information, which is presentation evidence rather than proof that the underlying endpoints failed to resolve.
Images failed to render after opening dashboard NFT details even though the asset endpoints were separately reported as resolving.
The blank View Book page concerns ebook-reader behavior rather than metadata or asset endpoint resolution.
The source reports stale referral and earnings values in NFT attributes, not endpoint-resolution failure.
With message 691 as context, this approval verifies the corrected live reward attributes rather than endpoint availability.
